description.value: Original Udder Guys is a scratch-made artisan ice cream parlour and retro candy shop on the Cowichan Bay waterfront, scooping from recipes perfected since 1999 and operating year-round under new ownership since 2023. The 24-flavour cabinet spans classics to inventive combinations alongside in-store fudge, imported British crisps and sweets, espresso drinks, milkshakes, and Slush Puppies. Cyclists can sit outside at picnic tables with a view of the bay or settle into indoor booths after a ride through the Cowichan Valley.

address.value: 1765 Cowichan Bay Road, Cowichan Bay, BC V0R 1N0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active ice cream and candy shop at 1765 Cowichan Bay Road, Cowichan Bay, BC (phone 250-746-4300), open year-round. The OSM name 'The Udder Guys' is the historical predecessor name; the current operating name is unambiguously 'Original Udder Guys' per the website branding, history page, and copyright notice. No information about bike parking, washrooms, or water refill appears anywhere on the site; outdoor picnic tables and indoor booths are confirmed, and dairy-free sorbets confirm at least one vegan-friendly product line.
